{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/gpt_oss/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_0/in.lammps", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion coefficient calculation
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate 3 3 3

# Interatomic potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
timestep 0.001   # 1 fs

# Define thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Heating from 300 K to 2500 K at 2.2 K/ps
variable t_start equal 300
variable t_end equal 2500
variable tdamp equal 0.1   # ps
variable pdamp equal 1.0   # ps

# NPT ensemble for heating
fix 1 all npt temp ${t_start} ${t_end} ${tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${pdamp}

# Run heating (1000 ps -> 1,000,000 steps)
run 1000000

# Unfix heating
unfix 1

# Equilibration at 2500 K for 500 ps
fix 2 all npt temp ${t_end} ${t_end} ${tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${pdamp}

# Compute MSD (center of mass)
compute mymsd all msd com yes
# Average MSD every 1000 steps and write to file
fix 3 all ave/time 1000 1 1000 c_mymsd file msd.dat mode vector

run 500000

unfix 2
unfix 3

# End of script
"}
